name: The Sunken Chapel of Neth
description: A drowned river-god's shrine and the cult that never left. Levels 1-2.

geometry: The nave's curved apse (source area 3) is squared to the grid: the two nave cells plus the reliquary cell approximate the organic curve behind the altar.
escape_hatch: The Black Font's scrying vision (area 'font_hall') has no SRD analogue; the referee adjudicates it live.
The Tear of Neth's scrying property (area 'reliquary') has no SRD analogue; its 500 gp stock value stands and any scrying is adjudicated live.
